justification: A var declaration is hoisted to the function scope and a let declaration introduces a temporal dead zone in its block. The resolver conservatively reports ambiguity between same-named symbols instead of resolving to the outer function.

cases.note: var-hoisted local target shadows the global; conservative ambiguity
